title: Pending Home Sales Index (NAR, November 2026) — the contracts-signed leading half of the closings this corridor already tracks
source: EST: nar.realtor/newsroom/nar-statistical-news-release-schedule and its .docx twin /sites/default/files/2025-11/2026-nar-statistical-news-release-schedule.docx, both fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200), whose 2026 table reads "DECEMBER | Thu., Dec. 17 | November Pending Home Sales Index" under the standing note "All releases are distributed at 10 a.m. Eastern Time". Filed `estimate` per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an in-sweep discovery. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the existing-home-sales-2026-12-09 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Why it earns its own row: existing-home sales counts CLOSINGS, so it reports contracts signed roughly 30-45 days earlier; the Pending Home Sales Index counts the contracts themselves and is therefore the leading half of the same measurement, published by the same body eight days later. Anyone reading the 12-09 print for a turn in housing demand is reading a lagging series when a leading one lands the following week. Two further readings belong with it. It is a NAR release, not a federal one, so like its 12-09 sibling it is immune to the 2026-12-11 funding cliff — which matters because the corridor's other residential input, Census's New Residential Construction (proposed separately as housing-starts-2026-12-17), lands the SAME MORNING at 08:30 and IS exposed; 12-17 is therefore the corridor's cleanest natural experiment on whether the cliff bites, two residential prints ninety minutes apart with opposite funding exposure. And unlike 12-09 it is on an ordinary session — the December FOMC decision is 12-09, so the PHSI tape is readable where the EHS tape is not. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measurement that keeps its sibling low (122 EHS release days since 2016: ITB 1.911% vs a 1.839% baseline, p=0.40); no house playbook is macro- or housing-keyed. NOT verified this session: whether the Atlanta Fed incorporates PHSI into GDPNow at all — its PostedUpdates names "Housing starts" on 2026-12-17 and does not name the PHSI, and no ContribArchives free text in the 1,871-vintage archive mentions it, so the initial research should treat a nowcast channel as unproven rather than assumed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
